answer: The queue moves one name at a time, and every name in it has already paid. Nobody is waved through free: a fare of £38 for the journey to the registry, paid per name is the price, and the forge never covers it twice. The island here is simple — no proof, no seat, and Licensed millwright guild licence is the proof, because a licence wrights renew after gear audits. The plume is checked, not assumed.
